name: @wizeworks/site-lint
description: Pre-publish check engine for silica sites (docs/builder-audit slices 9–10). lintSite() walks the COMPOSED document — frame ⊕ page body ⊕ expanded symbols — and reports broken links, missing image descriptions, heading-outline gaps, dead buttons, classes that emit no CSS, unreadable color pairings and missing/duplicate SEO fields. Pure, deterministic, no I/O, advisory only — it never blocks a publish.
